I replied to Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**.

That number comes from a #central-team conversation on Jul 2, 2025, which Hollis was part of and can see. In it, Tobias called #88412 the Tier 2 escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet freezing on the bill of lading (BOL) barcode scan. A ticket number is an operational fact, so it was fine to post in the channel.

The ticket isn't in the shared files (there's no Tansleigh folder there), so I couldn't check its current status. Also, the notes search ran in keyword-only mode, so anything worded differently could have been missed.
